bio.text: David Alvarez was elected to the California State Assembly in June 2022 to represent the 80th Assembly District, which includes Barrio Logan, Otay Mesa, San Ysidro, Chula Vista, National City and Imperial Beach.
Before the Assembly he was a small business owner and served for over fifteen years in government, including eight years as a San Diego City Councilmember.
He was born and raised in Barrio Logan, is the son of Mexican immigrants, and received a B.A. in psychology from San Diego State University.
